# ZbudujKompa

> ZbudujKompa is a free guide to building a PC, in Polish and English, by Dawid Olko: a configurator with compatibility checks, a parts catalogue, ready builds, calculators, guides and a glossary.

## Tools

- [PC configurator](https://zbudujkompa.dawidolko.pl/pl/konfigurator/): choose parts and check that they fit together
- [Compatibility checker](https://zbudujkompa.dawidolko.pl/pl/narzedzia/kompatybilnosc/): test a set of parts against each other
- [Calculators](https://zbudujkompa.dawidolko.pl/pl/kalkulatory/): power, clearance, noise, energy and more

## Knowledge

- [Guides](https://zbudujkompa.dawidolko.pl/pl/poradniki/): step-by-step PC building guides
- [Articles](https://zbudujkompa.dawidolko.pl/pl/artykuly/): explanations of specific buying decisions
- [Parts catalogue](https://zbudujkompa.dawidolko.pl/pl/podzespoly/): components by category and brand
- [Platforms](https://zbudujkompa.dawidolko.pl/pl/platformy/): CPU sockets and their chipsets
- [Ready builds](https://zbudujkompa.dawidolko.pl/pl/zestawy/): complete parts lists for typical uses
- [Glossary](https://zbudujkompa.dawidolko.pl/pl/slownik/): the terms explained

## Languages

- [Polish version](https://zbudujkompa.dawidolko.pl/pl/): the default language
- [English version](https://zbudujkompa.dawidolko.pl/en/): the same site in English

## Author

- [Dawid Olko](https://dawidolko.pl): Fullstack / AI Developer who built this site
